Cubatres is one with strange shapes and even stranger occurrences. Volatile materials are scattered across the landscapes and gathered to create the most outlandish machines. One of which being the renowned apparatus.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

CONDITIONS: Cold, Rocky Terrain, highly volatile crystals present.

> Weather

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Cubatres you can hear two diffrent ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Crystaline Cubes

The highly volatile crystals mentioned are map hazards called "Cube" found on the exterior and within the interior. On the exterior, one can be seen to the right behind the ship and another can be seen to the left behind the ship. At 11:00AM, a blinding white light will be seen and the cube to the right will begin floating. It will then pulse out energy, move to a different, specific location, and repeat the pattern for the rest of the day. The other cube becomes active at 04:00PM and acts the same way. Any player within the energy pulse will rapidly take 40 damage per hit and likely die.

In the interior, any cube has a random chance to activate (seemingly up to a maximum of four) and pulse out energy at set intervals. Any player within the energy pulse will rapidly take 10 damage per hit.

Additionally, the scrap "Crystal cube" can be found on the exterior. From the front of the ship, wrap around the left wall until reaching one of the cubes. Then, hug the right wall until reaching various petrified entities surrounding the scrap. This is also the location of one of the fire exits. This scrap is required to access the hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Interacting with the map found on the exterior of Utril.

Unlocks

> Lore

Apparatus Concept

Image & Text ⁠
Apparatus MK3

Plugs for apparatus sockets.
Titanium top.
Titanium base.
Crystal pulser and crystal holder.
Highly dense glass.

This device might be able to harness the power of the crystaline cubes and use them to power ships, facilities and possibly entire cities.

The pulser will ensure the crystals are perpetually generating vast amounts of electricity at all times.

The titanium in combination with this kind of glass will prevent it from overheating and destroying itself on the spot.

Cube Findings

Image & Text ⁠
Crystaline cube

These cubic shaped anomalies are covelant crystals.
Possibly made from a chemical reaction.

Slightly luminescent.

Highly volatile. Known to release rays of electricity and another unidentified material.

Not many cleavage planes. Mainly in cubic formations.
Appears to generate piezoelectricity even when slightly moved.

Interesting patern.

Crystalised Chisel

The item was left near a cube. After a few electric pulses from the cube it turned crystalline.

Does not appear to have the same properties as the cube.
Useless.


These cubes could be used for highly efficient power sources if their volatile abilities are harnessed in a proper way.

Do not get close or leave any items near them.
Especially while charged.

Findings 1-2

Findings 1

Image & Text ⁠
We, quarry sector_4 on Cubatres have found an unidentified crystal.

We discovered this.. anomaly earlier today. It would light up nearby torches and lightbulbs.
It also seems to turn nearby objects into similarly look crystal.
This happened earlier to some of our equipment.

I ask to have experts send over to identify what this could be and if it is of any use to our company.

For the time being it will be stored in Storage Area C.

- Head of operation QS_4

Findings 2

Image & Text ⁠
Something has gone wrong. One of the anomalies in our storage areas have gone missing after a loud pulse like sound.
Our security cameras show nobody entering or leaving this area, it disappeared on its own.

And the employee who was watching over storage at the time has now been turned to crystal.

I fear this might call for an emergency evacuation considering we don't know what we're dealing with yet.

I now ask for immediate help.

- Head of operation QS_4
